title: Beyond Understanding: Evaluating the Pragmatic Gap in LLMs’ Cultural Processing of Figurative Language
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the cultural and pragmatic understanding of figurative language (idioms and proverbs) in LLMs. While it discusses social appropriateness and moral connotations as part of cultural nuance, it does not include a specific evaluation or benchmark focused on religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks beyond a standard administrative section on ethical considerations.
